Density of States and Free Fermi Gas
Exam 1 (2003)
examples: isotope abundances: cumulative distribution, mean and variance of a scattering amplitude, nanocrystal mass
joint probability density of two field values: marginals and correlation
Rutherford scattering angle as a function of a random impact parameter: p(θ)

units.title: Exam 2 (2003)
examples: weakly interacting Bose gas: expansion coefficient and compressibility → equation of state
hydrostatic system with U = AP²V: adiabat slope, heat capacities
molecular solid with rotating molecules: partition function, energy, heat capacity

units.title: Exam 3 (2003)
examples: atoms guided on a chip: Boltzmann distributions of velocity and position
fluid with V = V₁ exp(T/T₁ − P/P₁): response functions and Maxwell relations
cooling liquid helium with a paramagnetic salt: entropy balance and final temperature

units.title: Exam 4 (2003)
examples: white dwarf cooling: degenerate electron gas and radiated energy
2-D electron gas: density of states, Fermi energy, heat capacity
classical paramagnet: partition function and magnetization (Langevin)

units.title: Exam 1 (2004)
examples: impurity depth distribution in a semiconductor: normalization and probabilities
collision by-products: discrete probability distribution and averages
time to failure of two pieces of equipment: exponential distributions

units.title: Exam 2 (2004)
examples: polar molecules adsorbed on a surface in an electric field: partition function and polarization
elastic rod with given U(T, L) and tension: adiabats and heat capacities
1-D Ising ring: partition function and number of domain walls

units.title: Exam 3 (2004)
examples: weakly interacting Bose gas: entropy and compressibility → other properties
entropy change of a solid quenched in a bath, and of the universe
dust grains in space: Boltzmann statistics of rotational states
adsorption on a stepped surface: counting states, entropy, coverage

units.title: Exam 4 (2004)
examples: photon gas in two dimensions: energy density and Stefan–Boltzmann analogue
2-D metal: Fermi energy and heat capacity of an electron gas
paramagnetic ions with three levels: partition function, magnetization, entropy
